Name: ArrowSwitchTarget
Notes: Target objects for ArrowSwitchMulti that activate their SW_A values when ArrowSwitchMulti's state corresponds with their assigned state.

Obj_arg0.Name: Target Group ID
Obj_arg0.Description: ID to be assigned to a group of four ArrowSwitchTarget objects and one ArrowSwitchMulti

Obj_arg1.Name: Target State
Obj_arg1.Description: The value from 0-3 that corresponds to ArrowSwitchMulti's state.

SW_A.Description: Activates when ArrowSwitchMulti's state matches Obj_arg1.
